title: Personal micro-experiment ledger — latency vs batch (Nadia)
content:
Micro-experiment ledger (compact) - notes to self
Purpose: quick place to track lots of tiny runs while iterating on batching + kv-cache tweaks. Not canonical — snapshots for PR text.

Columns: RunID | Date | Model | Quant | BatchSize | AvgSeq | Tokens | P50(ms) | P90(ms) | Cost/token | Comments

R-2026-001 | 2026-01-08 | redwood-7b | q4_0 | 1 | 32 | 28 | 72 | 118 | $0.0007 | baseline, no kv-cache, pipeline=sync
R-2026-002 | 2026-01-09 | redwood-7b | q4_0 | 4 | 32 | 112 | 92 | 154 | $0.0005 | batching reduces per-token cost, P90 increases slightly
R-2026-007 | 2026-01-15 | redwood-7b | q4_0 | 8 | 64 | 512 | 210 | 420 | $0.00033 | long seqs spike P90; look at kernel selection
R-2026-013 | 2026-01-21 | redwood-7b | q3_0 | 4 | 32 | 112 | 85 | 140 | $0.00042 | q3 quant helped latency slightly, cost lower
R-2026-018 | 2026-01-29 | redwood-7b | q3_0 | 4 | 128 | 448 | 190 | 310 | $0.00031 | kv-cache OFF; test with prefix cache next
R-2026-025 | 2026-02-05 | redwood-7b | q3_0 | 4 | 128 | 448 | 140 | 230 | $0.00032 | kv-cache ON (local), P90 improved by ~25%
R-2026-031 | 2026-02-11 | redwood-7b | q3_0 | 16 | 32 | 512 | 160 | 290 | $0.00024 | large batching w/kv-cache; tail still noisy
R-2026-039 | 2026-02-18 | redwood-7b | q3_0 | 16 | 64 | 1024 | 265 | 520 | $0.00019 | memory pressure observed, consider partial batching

Quick observations:
- Small batch sizes (1-4) keep P50 low; P90 worsens with longer avg seq length.
- Quantization to q3_0 often saves latency without major quality loss on our prompts.
- KV-cache yields consistent P90 improvements for multi-turn workloads; must measure memory tradeoffs.
- Very large batches (>=16) reduce cost/token significantly but increase tail latency and memory faults.

To-do (short):
- [ ] Re-run R-2026-031 with async pipeline + prefetching (ticket INF-1287)
- [ ] Add small quality eval (5 prompts) for q3_0 vs q4_0 to verify no regressions
- [ ] Capture GPU mem histogram at 1s granularity for runs with batch>=8
- [ ] Try hybrid batch strategy: batch within latency SLO, fallback to single-run for cold keys

Scratch notes & teardown ideas:
- For canary: use batch size 4 with q3_0 + kv-cache ON as default for low-latency chat, rollback to q4_0 if quality drop >2 BLEU-like metric points.
- If P90 > target (300ms) on a route, auto-route to dedicated pool with smaller batches.

Recent command snippets I used (psuedo):
- run_bench --model redwood-7b --quant q3_0 --batch 4 --seq 128 --kv on --out csv >> microledger.csv
- collect_gpu_hist --out r-2026-031-mem.json --interval 1s

Notes-to-self: keep this compact. When consolidating for PR, move cleaned table to shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/bench-reports/ with full stat calculations and plots.

End of ledger snapshot (Nadia)
